name: Floor push-up
definition: Support the body on hands and toes with the hands on the floor. Lower the torso by bending the elbows, then press back to the raised position.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Support the body on hands and toes with the hands on the floor.
value.movement: Lower the torso by bending the elbows, then press back to the raised position.
value.finish: Return to the same hands-and-toes support.
value.range_of_motion: Use a repeatable chest-approach endpoint while retaining the trunk position.
